title: UR3 Voice Control with ROS 2 and ROSA
description:
Voice control of a Universal Robots UR3 collaborative manipulator in Italian. Speech is transcribed with OpenAI Whisper and interpreted by the NASA JPL ROSA agent with GPT-4o, which can only call four tools (absolute move, relative move, home, end session) that publish JSON commands on a ROS 2 topic. A ROS 2 Humble and MoveIt 2 pipeline checks straight-line reachability before executing each motion, on a Gazebo digital twin or on the real robot.

Developed as a Bachelor's thesis in Industrial Automation Engineering at the University of Brescia (A.Y. 2025/2026), supervisor Prof. Riccardo Adamini. Includes instructions to reproduce the system in simulation without hardware.
